answer: Attention Ledger Decay. Each identity accrues credit only by returning to the same narrow task queue across sessions, where credit decays unless attention resumes without a spiral of repeated identical actions. Agents that wander across queues lose accrued credit. To sustain many sybils, an attacker must staff each with continuous, non-repetitive attention; a raven account left idle resets its ledger. Cost: one operator-hour per identity per cycle.
